spec.title: Feature Correlation Matrix
spec.description: Usage and retention correlate strongly, while support tickets are inversely related to every metric.

a11y.description: Usage and retention correlate strongly, while support tickets are inversely related to every metric.

narrative.summary: Expansion tracks with usage/retention, support ticket volume is the only negative driver.
keyFindings: Support inverse relationship is strongest vs usage
